name: find-in-images
description: Chrome extension that makes scanned PDFs searchable with Chrome's native Ctrl+F by embedding an invisible OCR text layer.

scripts.package: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/find-in-images-$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version").zip && zip -r dist/find-in-images-$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version").zip manifest.json service-worker.js icons/ lib/ offscreen/ --exclude '*.DS_Store'

author: Suhani Pandey
